dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to have a chat.

dialogues.speaker: Banu
dialogues.text: Ah, this I can really relate to. It gets boring easier than you'd believe when you are out in the wild all by yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Banu
dialogues.text: When I was at home, I had so many things to do every day. Apart from all the housework, I had to cook meals for Shalmar with Apple, or else he'd have nothing to eat and starve.

dialogues.speaker: Banu
dialogues.text: Those were some busy days, but I never felt bored. But now, I'm away from home and all by myself, so I understand how you feel completely.
